summary: FASE SL RFID Auto-Tag + Alias Katalog MD verified end-to-end. Backend 9/9 pass (100%). Frontend: warehouse scan-label panel shows EPC badges, print buttons per row, and print-actions block (popup+queue) with live queue info; scanning TB-UI1 auto-encodes RFID and appends a new row (3rd EPC badge). WMS Stok tab displays 'pabrik: CBN-MEGA-PREM — Batik Cap Mega Mendung Premium' balance-supplier-alias rows. MD catalog (ptpl_ec3683557d1bad0da326) shows catalog-supplier-alias-prod_benang_katun 'pabrik: SLW-YARN-30S' and header catalog-selected-supplier-alias 'Versi supplier: SLW-YARN-30S — Cotton Combed 30s Cone 1,89 Kg (Solo Weave)'.
critical_code_review_comments: In backend list_scanned_rolls response payload, roll rows use auto-generated internal roll_no (e.g. RL-00060); the supplier-provided label roll number goes into supplier_roll_no. Consumers looking up by 'roll_no' must be aware of this. Documented for future tests.
DELETE /api/rfid/tags/{tag_id} keeps historical EPC uniqueness against 'active' tags; retrying the same test EPC after delete may still 409 in some paths — parametrize test EPCs (done in this suite).
